returned_verdict.verdict: all five prior findings addressed in this diff; three low-severity test/coverage gaps remain
resolved: 1: constructor-failure test (sanitized RuntimeError, no output dir) and abstain-with-lineup_order-4 test added; abstain yields execution_status completed.

2: _summarize derives execution_status per role-reading; main() returns 2 only for no_usable_observations and __main__ now raises SystemExit(main()); CLI test verifies exit 2 while both error rows and report.json are preserved.

3: additive comparison_summary partitions read rows by temporal_relation and counts non-read rows separately; legacy roles.*.not_compared retained and its mixed meaning documented in comparison_definition. Test arithmetic (legacy 3 vs read 2/1/1 + non_read 1 over 5 frames) is internally consistent with per-row previous-reset semantics.
4: engine identity equal to 'redacted' now rejected with the generic message before any frame read or output write; test asserts calls == 0 and no out dir.

5: _inputs wraps _validated_inputs, mapping ValueError/KeyError/TypeError/OSError/AttributeError/OverflowError (covers JSONDecodeError, UnicodeDecodeError, FileNotFoundError, UnidentifiedImageError) to ValueError('malformed pack') from None; test asserts exact message, __suppress_context__ True, zero reader and metadata calls, no output.

findings.detail: test_constructor_failure_is_sanitized_and_creates_no_output never asserts the fake constructor was invoked. If run() bound SNYPlayerNameReader at import time, the monkeypatch on src.vision.sny_player_names is inert and the test passes only when the real constructor happens to raise RuntimeError on the host. Add a call flag.

Unlike the malformed-pack test, the init-failure test checks only str(error.value), not __cause__/__suppress_context__. If the production wrapper chains implicitly, the CLI traceback still prints the original path-bearing message.
IndexError (empty pitches/frames lists indexed) and PIL DecompressionBombError are outside the caught tuple; reachability depends on the unchanged _validated_inputs body, not visible here.

limits: Static read of the diff only; _validated_inputs body, reader construction site, ROLES, write ordering, and test helpers (Reader, reading, fixture_pack, seal) were not visible.
completed_with_errors exits 0 by stated design; exit code alone does not signal partial failure, callers must parse execution_status.
_summarize raises bare ValueError('observations required') on zero rows; if zero-frame packs were previously reportable this is a behavior change, otherwise unreachable.
The generic wrapper also collapses previously specific, non-leaking messages (invalid pitch key, receipt/sha mismatch) into 'malformed pack', reducing diagnosability.
No tests were executed; the 29-pass claim is not independently verified.
